questions.prompt: What is the big idea of Reptiles?
choices: Reptiles have traits that help them live.
Only reptiles have dry scaly skin.
Only snakes are reptiles without legs.
questions.answer: Reptiles have traits that help them live.
questions.rationale: Reptiles have dry scaly skin. Snakes are reptiles without legs. Outside heat changes reptile body temperature. Together, these facts show the whole-book big idea: Reptiles have traits that help them live.
